description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client that is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息。
description.en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the regions that support asynchronous replication.
